svg.aria-label: Scopes: platform-admin, tenant, user. Enforced on the token, never the prompt. Where it fits: synthwerk-widgets and SDK apps call the gateway. It reads service tools through read-only MCP tools and publishes events to the NATS bus. Ecosystem: Ecosystem map: synthwerk (https://github.com/VelimirMueller/synthwerk). Shared CI: synthwerk-blueprint (https://github.com/VelimirMueller/synthwerk-blueprint). The old code: Tag legacy-final holds a Flask + GPT4All WebSocket demo, one shared session for all users. Renamed: This repo was renamed. The old URL still redirects here. Branching: main deploys to dev, a vX.Y.Z tag to stg, an approved digest to prd
